1.text: Ntimwumva ko Bwenge ashyira ejuru,Akarangurura ijwi ry'ubuhanga?

2.text: Ahagaze mu mpinga z'imisozi,Mu mahuriro y'inzira.

3.text: Mu marembo no mu miharuro y'umurwa,Ashyira ejuru ari mu bikingi by'amarembo ati

4.text: “Yemwe bagabo, ni mwe mpamagara,N'abana b'abantu ni bo ijwi ryanjye ribwira.

5.text: Yemwe mwa njiji mwe, nimujijuke,Namwe mwa bapfu mwe, mugire umutima usobanukiwe.

6.text: Nimwumve ngiye kuvuga ibikomeye,Kandi umunwa wanjye ndawubumburira kuvuga ibitunganye.

7.text: Kuko akanwa kanjye kaza kuvuga ukuri,Kandi gukiranirwa ari ikizira kuri jye.

8.text: Amagambo yo mu kanwa kanjye yose ni akiranuka,Nta buriganya cyangwa ubugoryi buyabamo.

10.text: Aho gushaka ifeza mutore ibyo nigisha,Mushake ubwenge kuburutisha izahabu nziza.

11.text: “Kuko ubwenge buruta amabuye ya marijani,Kandi mu bintu byifuzwa byose nta gihwanye na bwo.

12.text: Jyewe Bwenge nagize umurava ho ubuturo bwanjye,Mfite ubwenge bwo kugenzura.

13.text: Kūbaha Uwiteka ni ukwanga ibibi,Ubwibone n'agasuzuguro n'inzira y'ibibi,N'akanwa k'ubugoryi ni byo nanga.

14.text: Ni jye nyir'inama no kumenya gutunganye,Ni jye Muhanga kandi mfite n'ububasha.

15.text: Ni jye wimika abami,Ngaha ibikomangoma guca imanza zitabera.

16.text: Ni jye uha abatware gutwara,N'imfura na zo ndetse n'abacamanza bo mu isi bose.

18.text: Ubukire n'icyubahiro biri iwanjye,Kandi n'ubutunzi buhoraho, no gukiranuka na byo.

19.text: Imbuto zanjye ziruta izahabu,ni ukuri ziruta izahabu nziza,Kandi indamu yanjye iruta ifeza y'indobanure.

20.text: Ngendera mu nzira yo gukiranuka,No mu nzira z'imanza zitabera,

21.text: Kugira ngo ntungishe abankunda,Nuzuze ububiko bwabo.

22.text: “Uwiteka mu itangira ry'imirimo ye yarangabiye,Ataragira icyo arema.

23.text: Uhereye kera kose narimitswe,Uhereye mbere na mbere isi itararemwa.

24.text: Ikuzimu hatarabaho naragaragajwe,Amasōko adudubiza amazi menshi ataraboneka.

26.text: Yari itararema isi no mu bweru,N'umukungugu w'isi utaratumuka.

27.text: Igihe yaringanije amajuru nari mpari,Igihe yashingaga urugabano rw'ikuzimu,

28.text: Mu gihe yakomereje ijuru hejuru,No mu gihe amasōko y'ikuzimu yahawe imbaraga,

29.text: Igihe yahaye inyanja urubibi rwayo,Kugira ngo amazi atarenga itegeko ryayo,Kandi no mu gihe yagaragaje imfatiro z'isi.

30.text: Icyo gihe nari kumwe na yo ndi umukozi w'umuhanga,Kandi nari umunezero wayo iminsi yose,Ngahora nezerewe imbere yayo,

31.text: Nkishimira mu isi yayo yaremewe guturwamo,Kandi ibinezeza byanjye byari ukubana n'abantu.

32.text: “Nuko rero bana banjye nimunyumvire,Kuko hahirwa abakomeza inzira zanjye.

34.text: Hahirwa umuntu unyumvira,Akaba maso mu marembo yanjye iminsi yose,Agategerereza ku nkomo z'imiryango yanjye.

35.text: Kuko umbonye wese aba abonye ubugingo,Kandi azahabwa umugisha n'Uwiteka,

36.text: Ariko uncumuraho aba yononnye ubugingo bwe,Abanyanga bose baba bakunze urupfu.”
